title: [SPR1-017] ADR-007: Hosting on Render (Free tier) + SLO note
body:
Objective: document hosting decision & constraints (DB expiry, cold starts).

DoD:
- Add ADR-007 capturing Render Free tier pros/cons and mitigations.
- Update SLOs-SLIs.md to exclude cold-starts from latency SLO and track 'first-hit after idle'.
- Update Scope CHANGELOG with hosting decision.

Acceptance:
- ADR merged and referenced from Scope CHANGELOG.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR1-018] Render blueprint: render.yaml + service wiring
body:
Objective: scaffold deploy to Render Free tier.

DoD:
- Add render.yaml (API Docker service, Web Node service, Free Postgres).
- Health check path /health for API.
- Document required env vars in README (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL via Render DB binding).

Acceptance:
- Render blueprint validates; services show 'pending connect' state.

Estimate: 2 pts
